samples.description:
a power of two plus one; 2049 unless there is a reason

scale.description: the whole height budget in metres — everything is quantised against it, so keep it just above the tallest thing on the track

amplitude.description: the landscape's own hills, peak to trough, metres

tilt.description: metres the whole plot falls from one side to the other — a hillside rather than a plain. 0 for flat ground, 20-30 for a hillside national.

tiltAngle.description: which way it falls, degrees, same convention as a heading

landforms.description:
how many banks and spoil hills the venue has around the track. 0 for a bare field, 10-15 for a proper venue. These are what make a plot look built rather than generated.

{minimum: -9007199254740991, maximum: 9007199254740991}

landformHeight.description: how tall the tallest of them stands, metres; 12-18 is normal

surface.description: what the ground is. It decides how the track rides as well as how it looks: sand cuts deeper ruts, banks bigger berms and replaces the braking washboard with long swells; grass barely wears at all.

wear.description: how raced the ground arrives, 0 to 1. 0 is freshly prepped — the shapes are there but the grooves are not, and the ground has its whole depth left to give over a session. 1 is a Sunday afternoon, everything worn in. 0.55 is a track that has seen a session; pick from the brief.

roughness.description: how rough the ridden ground is, 1 to 2. 1 is a national; 2 is a raced ARL track, rougher everywhere with bigger jumps' ground worked in

angle.description: degrees; 0 looks down +z and increases clockwise towards +x

blend.description: metres things ease into each other over: where two jumps meet, where a straight becomes a corner, and how long a jump's own ramps are. 1.2 is normal; 0 is every edge sharp

elevation.description: the lap height as a curve; leave empty to follow the landscape

height.description: metres above the ground the track would otherwise follow

rise.description: metres the ground climbs over this segment; negative drops, 0 follows the land

radius.description: metres, signed — positive turns right, negative turns left

rise.description: metres the ground climbs over this segment; negative drops, 0 follows the land

at.description: metres round the lap from the start

length.description: tabletop/roller/stepUp/berm/rut/custom; 0 otherwise. A tabletop's is its WHOLE footprint, ramp to ramp

height.description: metres, all but rut and custom; for stepUp the ground gained, negative for a step down; 0 otherwise

gap.description: double: metres of flat ground between the two jumps; 0 otherwise

lip.description: tabletop: metres of take-off when it wants to be longer and gentler than its height makes it, 0 to leave it to the angle; double: metres of takeoff face; 0 otherwise

spacing.description: whoops: metres crest to crest; 0 otherwise

shape.description: custom: heights along the feature, u running 0 at its start to 1 at its end; [] otherwise

finish.description: tabletop/double: true for the one finish jump on the start straight; false otherwise

side.description: custom: 0 across the whole width, 1 or -1 to stand it on the right or left half only; 0 otherwise
